orientationMethod.matrixConvention: 3 rows of 3 columns; multiply body-fixed [x,y,z] column-vector to get ICRF. Body +Z is IAU pole; +X crosses prime meridian. SPICE J2000 label is ICRF for these IAU constants. Apply the same fixed ICRF-to-renderer mapping to both positions and orientations.
orientationMethod.accuracyNote: IAU cartographic orientation model, not full modern Earth ITRF/polar-motion or lunar binary-PCK solution. Gas-giant cloud features are not rigid surfaces and texture date is independent of ephemeris epoch. Hyperion chaotic rotation cannot be represented accurately by a fixed standard IAU model.
